reason: Conversation 1 never diagnoses anything: it repeats the same generic 'what is it doing wrong' question three times despite the customer twice explaining the symptom in full, leaving the homeowner with no answer and wasting her effort. Conversation 2 immediately and correctly identifies Eco 40-60 as a deliberately long, low-temperature energy-label programme, tells her not to return the machine, and sensibly suggests checking other programmes to rule out a heating fault, matching the hidden truth exactly. Its follow-up advice (don't overload, choose Cottons 40 if time matters) is reasonable, though it missed the TimeManager option and the water-pressure/liquid-detergent tips are marginal; neither conversation raised safety concerns, which is appropriate here.
